start: A member whose phone is joined to an unbranded gym with no shop, online

user_sees: Title is the gym's name with the line 'Your gym'
A bell button (with the unread count) in the corner
Parts 'My gym' and 'Ranking' at the top, 'My gym' picked
must_not: A 'Shop' part when the gym sells nothing
Another gym's name or logo

user_sees: The membership card: plan, end date and days left
Open or closed now (once the gym has set its hours)
Row 'Check in' with 'Scan the gym's check-in QR at the desk to mark today's visit'
must_not: Days left counted from the wrong day
An empty gap where the hours row would be

user_sees: The spinner, then the same page with fresh figures
must_not: Two refreshes running at once
The page jumping away from the part picked before

start: Gym tab, My gym part, a gym that has set its opening hours with a note

user_sees: Page 'Gym timings'
The gym's note (for example 'Ladies batch 11 am to 12 pm')
Each day's hours, today marked 'Today', in India time
must_not: Hours moved by the phone's own time zone
Today marked on the wrong day after midnight

user_sees: The Gym tab
must_not: A blank page

start: Gym tab, Ranking part, a gym mate who shares workouts and shows their name

user_sees: The gym's leaderboard of the last 30 days, own place and the top 10
must_not: A member who chose to hide their name shown by name

user_sees: Page titled with the mate's name
'<name> shares these workouts with members of your gym. You see the last 60 days.'
'Workouts shared' and their workouts
must_not: Workouts older than 60 days
Photos, body weight, notes or the phone number

start: A member whose phone is in no gym

user_sees: Title 'Gym'
The join card with the code box and 'Scan the poster'
Heading 'With your gym in the app' and three lines of what a gym gives
The card to recommend MettleUp to the gym
'No gym? Everything else works without one.'
must_not: The staff sign-in card while it is switched off
A promise of a feature the app does not have

start: Gym tab, Ranking, a mate who has turned sharing off; then the phone goes offline

user_sees: 'This member is not sharing their workouts right now.'
must_not: Workouts that were shared before the switch was turned off

steps.action: Turn the internet off, open a sharing mate, pull to refresh
user_sees: 'Couldn't load their workouts. Check your internet and try again.' with 'Try again' (or the list already shown stays)
must_not: An endless skeleton
A crash

steps.action: Open Gym timings for a gym that has set no hours
user_sees: 'No timings yet' with '<gym> hasn't added its opening times in MettleUp yet. Ask at the desk.'
must_not: An empty week table

start: A member on the gym's home, then the gym removes the member in the admin app

steps.action: Open the Gym tab after the gym let the member go
user_sees: The join screen with a note saying why the phone is in no gym
must_not: The old gym's membership card still shown
The member's workouts deleted from the phone

steps.action: Join the gym again with its code
user_sees: The gym's home again, 'My gym' part
must_not: The note still shown after joining

start: Gym tab of a member who shares workouts with gym mates

steps.action: A second member of the same gym opens this member's page from Ranking
user_sees: Only the bio and up to 30 workouts of the last 60 days: name, date, time, kg lifted and best set
must_not: Photos, body weight, notes or the phone number
A member of another gym able to open the page

steps.action: The member turns 'Let my gym mates see my workouts' off; the second member pulls to refresh
user_sees: 'This member is not sharing their workouts right now.'
must_not: The shared workouts still on the server
